summary: This trace shows a common and painful anti-pattern: the agent repeatedly failed due to using ' Bash' (with a leading space) as the tool name instead of 'Bash'. This is a deterministic, high-frequency failure mode that future agents should avoid. The task itself involves parsing messy Excel inventory data with pandas (header rows not in row 0, date calculations, stock/run-out day forecasting). I will capture both the tool name anti-pattern and the pandas Excel parsing workflow to help future agents avoid these pitfalls and handle similar inventory/forecasting tasks more reliably.
